programme.title: Computer Science, B.S. (Engineering)
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science (College of Engineering), University Park plan CMPSC_BS
programme.how_found: Undergraduate Bulletin entry; admissions facts from www.psu.edu/admission/undergraduate and www.psu.edu/resources/international-students (university-wide, scoped to the university).
programme.notes: Students are admitted to the College of Engineering / Division of Undergraduate Studies and enter the major later (Entrance to Major: minimum cumulative GPA 3.20 after 29-55 Penn State credits).

value.other: TOEFL iBT 4.5 (tests after 21 January 2026) or 80 (before); Duolingo 120; SAT EBRW 570; ACT English 24

english.quote: A minimum IELTS score of 6.5 on the academic test
english.notes: University-wide requirement for first-year international students; no per-section minimum published. TOEFL, IELTS and Duolingo scores must be less than two years old.

gpa.notes: No minimum high-school GPA published for admission (holistic review, STARS self-reported academic record; test-optional). The 3.20 GPA in the bulletin is the entrance-to-major threshold after 29-55 Penn State credits, not an admission requirement.

deadline.quote: Recommended submission deadline for all applications: December 1
deadline.notes: Printed without a year; for Fall 2027 entry it is 1 December 2026. It is a RECOMMENDED date for all applications (international included), not a hard close. Same page: 'For Early Action: Apply by November 1 in order to receive a decision by December 24'. International application fee $75.

tuition.notes: Not readable as published text: tuition.psu.edu (the Bursar's tuition schedules) answers 403 to our user agent. Penn State Global 'University Park Undergraduates: Breakout of Expenses' (https://global.psu.edu/page/university-park-undergraduates-breakout-expenses) has a table, rendered client-side (absent from the readable text), of I-20 estimates: '1st and 2nd Year Students $45,000' tuition and fees, 'All Other Upper Division Programs $47,100'; academic year not stated (its PDF is named 2025-up-hy-gv-estimates.pdf). An estimate for visa forms, not the published tuition schedule; not quoted.

value.name: Special International Grant-in-Aid (SIGIA) and Penn State Tuition Assistance Grant (PSTAG)

scholarship_exists.quote: Penn State University has authorized two scholarship funds that provide a limited number of tuition grants exclusively for international students
scholarship_exists.notes: For CURRENTLY ENROLLED international students ('exclusively for currently enrolled international students'), applied for in iStart (due June 15 for fall, October 15 for spring); 'Typically, these grants range from $100 to $2000.' 'these are the only tuition scholarships for which undergraduate international students are eligible.' Breakout of Expenses page: 'There is, at this time, essentially no financial aid available for international undergraduate students.' PARTIAL, competitive (staff committee).

scholarship_international.quote: these are the only tuition scholarships for which undergraduate international students are eligible
scholarship_international.notes: International undergraduates are eligible, but only once enrolled; no entry award for a first-year applicant.
